race.name: Race / Hispanic origin
race.numerator_universe: Total population (each person in exactly one category)
race.note: Hispanic or Latino people of any race are one category; other categories are non-Hispanic.

hispanic.name: Hispanic or Latino origin (detailed)
hispanic.numerator_universe: Total population (Hispanic or Latino people by specific origin)

asian.name: Asian groups (detailed)
asian.numerator_universe: Asian-alone population (people who reported only Asian race)
asian.note: Counts only people who reported Asian as their only race; multiracial people with Asian heritage are not counted. Shares are of all residents.

ancestry.name: Ancestry
ancestry.numerator_universe: Total population; people may report up to two ancestries
ancestry.note: A person who reports two ancestries is counted in both, so ancestry categories overlap and are never added together.

birthplace.name: Country of birth
birthplace.numerator_universe: Foreign-born population only (U.S.-born people are not counted)
birthplace.note: Counts only immigrants born in the country. Puerto Rico is part of the U.S. and is not a country of birth in this table. Shares are of all residents.

language.name: Language spoken at home
language.note: At tract level only 12 broad language categories exist (the detailed table B16001 is not published for tracts). Most categories are buckets that cover many groups.
